Ranks all Montgomery census tracts by listed pharmacies per 10,000 residents ascending, left-joining pre-aggregated pharmacy counts and CDC total population so zero-pharmacy tracts are retained and null populations sort last.
sql:
WITH pharmacy_counts AS (
  SELECT geoid, CAST(n AS DOUBLE) AS pharmacy_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261026_3c8c1a' AND source = 'm1_city' AND grp = 'all'
),
pop AS (
  SELECT tractfips AS geoid, CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation
  FROM session.fw_3c8c1a_m2_cdc
)
SELECT
  t.name,
  (COALESCE(pc.pharmacy_count, 0) / pop.totalpopulation * 10000) AS pharmacies_per_10000_residents,
  COALESCE(pc.pharmacy_count, 0) AS pharmacy_count,
  pop.totalpopulation,
  t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN pharmacy_counts pc ON t.geoid = pc.geoid
LEFT JOIN pop ON t.geoid = pop.geoid
ORDER BY pharmacies_per_10000_residents ASC NULLS LAST, t.name ASC
LIMIT 200
